name: 200. GPT rolling cache markers preserve implicit lookup (gpt cache mode)
description: Claude Code sends two system cache_control markers and a rolling tool_result marker. Inferring prompt_cache_options.mode=explicit disables implicit lookup at earlier eligible message endings and loses conversation reuse. Pin the outbound policy on the Anthropic Bedrock route for both request shapes, on native Responses including streaming, and with caller-selected explicit mode. All default cases fail before the fix because the raw request selects explicit mode. These cases validate translation and policy; provider cache hits remain best effort. Uses the standard harness bedrock_openai_ep provider, whose key enables use_openai_endpoints for runtime frontier models.
